from PIL import Image

    "xxhdpi": {"launcher": 144, "foreground": 324},
    "xxxhdpi": {"launcher": 192, "foreground": 432}
}

img = Image.open(src_png)

for density, dims in sizes.items():
    density_dir = os.path.join(res_dir, f"mipmap-{density}")
    os.makedirs(density_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    # 1. Standard Launcher Icon
    launcher_sz = dims["launcher"]
    launcher_img = img.resize((launcher_sz, launcher_sz), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    launcher_img.save(os.path.join(density_dir, "ic_launcher.png"), "PNG")
    launcher_img.save(os.path.join(density_dir, "ic_launcher_round.png"), "PNG")
    print(f"Generated standard and round launcher icons ({launcher_sz}x{launcher_sz}) for {density}")
    
    # 2. Foreground Adaptive Icon (Artwork centered inside a transparent container)
    fg_sz = dims["foreground"]
    fg_img = Image.new("RGBA", (fg_sz, fg_sz), (0, 0, 0, 0))
    
    # Scale icon to about 65% of the foreground container to keep it in the safe zone
    icon_sz = int(fg_sz * 0.65)
    resized_icon = img.resize((icon_sz, icon_sz), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    
    # Center paste
    offset = (fg_sz - icon_sz) // 2
    fg_img.paste(resized_icon, (offset, offset), resized_icon if resized_icon.mode == 'RGBA' else None)
    fg_img.save(os.path.join(density_dir, "ic_launcher_foreground.png"), "PNG")
    print(f"Generated adaptive foreground icon ({fg_sz}x{fg_sz}) for {density}")

print("All icons successfully generated and matched with the favicon!")
"
